senses.definition_en: salty

examples.english: After crossing a wooden bridge, its rotten piles sunk in the salty muck, we climb a hill (we’re nearly to Ficobriga) from which we can see the estuary, turning in circles as if it knows not where it is going, nor where is the sea that awaits it, getting into the marsh’s every puddle with high tide, and quickly fleeing them once it begins to ebb.
examples.text: Después de atravesar un puente de madera, que sumerge en el salobre fango sus podridos pilotes, subimos una cuesta (casi estamos ya en Ficóbriga), desde la cual se ve la ría, dando vueltas como si no supiera a dónde va, ni dónde está el mar que la espera, metiéndose en todos los charcos de las marismas cuando hay marea, y huyendo de ellos aprisa desde que empieza la baja.
examples.translation: After crossing a wooden bridge, its rotten piles sunk in the salty muck, we climb a hill (we’re nearly to Ficobriga) from which we can see the estuary, turning in circles as if it knows not where it is going, nor where is the sea that awaits it, getting into the marsh’s every puddle with high tide, and quickly fleeing them once it begins to ebb.

glosses: salty
